description: issue #673: `who` (Sprites, R/0->turtle) reports the current turtle, which at top level (no `tell`/`ask`/`each`, all SP2+) is the single default main turtle. `who` equals `first turtles` because both denote the main turtle and turtle `==` compares the stable id (C3), not the JS wrapper instance. The comparison is written directly as `print who == first turtles`: a zero-arg reporter is a valid left operand of `==`. (Only the *parenthesized* form `(who == first turtles)` would fail, because `(name args ...)` is variadic-call syntax in OpenLogo, not grouping -- `spec/grammar.md` has no `( expression )` production.)
